instrument_scope: any pair permitted; actual retrieved instruments must be reported
evaluation_note: 52 complete Monday weeks. Data predates cutoff and overlaps earlier project research. Not a globally untouched holdout.
selection: Choose each family's top development candidate, then choose overall non-cash candidate by validation geometric weekly return. Freeze before evaluation. Cash if no candidate has positive validation return. Report rejected positive development candidates too.
sizing: 0.25%, 0.5%, 1% planned equity risk per trade; 20x gross entry cap; modeled fees/slippage included in risk; no martingale

execution.entry: next minute open after completed signal
execution.book_impact: unavailable, volume cap is an approximation

subminute: Four historical trade-sample days only. Sample diagnostics must not be annualized or described as a full-year 1s test.
live_orders: disabled; no accounts or credentials required

instrument_grid_assumptions.verification: Conservative modeling assumptions, not independently verified historical exchange filters. New instruments need instrument-specific verified filters.

revision_note: Order-grid and minimum-order execution correctness repair after V3.0 evaluation, not outcome-driven parameter optimization. Original definitions, source, frozen choices and results retained in revisions/pre_order_grid. All outputs rerun, prior test exposure disclosed.
